> 道者，萬物之奧。善人之寶，不善人之所保.

Chapter 61 followed the water down to the lowest place. Chapter 62 says exactly where that lowest place is: a corner of a room.

## 奧 is the southwest corner

奧: 宛也。室之西南隅 — the southwest corner of a house.

In that arrangement, the corner is the seat of honor — the place where the household's elder sits — and it is also the darkest, the most interior, the place 不見戶明: where the light from the door does not reach.

So 萬物之奧 is not "the profound mystery of all things." It is: that corner. The place everything is already in, and the place nobody looks at.

## 善人之寶，不善人之所保

To the good, it is a treasure; to the not-good, it is what shelters them.

保: to carry a child on the back — the 保 of 襁褓. The not-good person is not the one holding the Dao; he is the one being carried by it, and does not know.

## 美言可以市尊，美行可以加人

Fine speech can be traded for esteem; fine conduct can add to a person's standing.

市 is to trade at a market. So eloquence is currency, and it buys rank.

The line is not a compliment. It is the setup for the next sentence.

## 人之不善，何棄之有？

If someone is not good, what is there to throw away?

The question is the answer. Nothing is discarded, because the corner holds everyone — including those who have no fine speech and no fine conduct, and therefore no market value.

It is the same argument as chapter 49's 不善者，吾亦善之, arriving from the other side: not "be generous to them," but "there is no mechanism for discarding them."

## 立天子，置三公

Set up the son of heaven, install the three ministers. 雖有拱璧以先駟馬 — even with a jade disc carried ahead and four horses behind.

The ceremonial is described precisely: a jade held in both hands, then a team of four. This is the most expensive protocol available.

不如坐進此道 — it is not as good as 坐進 this Dao.

## 坐進 is a contradiction

坐: 止也 — to stop, to be seated.
進: 登也 — to go up, to advance.

So 坐進 is "seated, advancing." Two verbs that cancel each other in ordinary use.

That is the point. The approach to the corner is not a journey — there is no distance to cover, because you are already in the room. Advancing is the wrong motion; stopping is the arrival.

## 求以得，有罪以免

Asked for, and it is obtained; having fault, and it is remitted.

免 is to be released from — the same 免 as in a debt being cleared. The chapter does not say the fault was never committed. It says the exposure that came with it is lifted.

## Why the corner

61: the river's lower reach — the place the water goes.
62: the room's southwest corner — the place the light doesn't reach.

Both are low, both are where things arrive, and neither is a place one would choose to look at. The chapter's claim is that the thing being described has been located all along, and the only difficulty is that it is in the dark part of the house.

## A test

Think of the person or situation you have written off as not worth the effort. The chapter says there is no mechanism for discarding them — and that the reason they are not discarded is not moral, but structural: the corner holds them.
